name: Team 750
description: Only picks jobs that can break elemental rods or have a similar play style (rods cost 750 gil).

name: Team No 750
description: Only picks jobs that cannot break elemental rods and follow that same non-caster play style (rods cost 750 gil).

name: Team 375
description: Splits the run down the middle: two jobs are drawn from the Team 750 pool and two from the Team No 750 pool. Forces Allow Duplicates.

name: Team Vibe Coded
description: Ships a party that compiles. One slot must be a physical job, one a mage, one a support job, and one more a fighter - assigned in a random order. No healerless parties, no all-caster parties, no reading the docs first. Not an official Four Job Fiesta job set.
